reason: With around 40 technicians, ₹199 each comes to about ₹8,000 every month, double what the ₹99 job apps charge. I might let them run the free month, but I won't pay double just because the report is voice instead of typed.
objection: Other job apps are ₹99 per technician. For a team my size, that ₹100 extra per head turns into almost a lakh a year, and my coordinator already handles AMC reminders.
would_change_my_mind: A per-technician price close to ₹99, or a flat company rate for 25+ technicians, plus proof from the trial that the AMC reminders actually bring in renewals I would otherwise lose.
